confidence_notes: Medium overall, low for accommodation and wine. Food anchors rest on third-party cost-of-living pages (Wise, Nomad Watch) and Thai baht menu ranges, not live menus. Cappuccino draws on a French price-comparison estimate and a Koh Lipe reference. Beer and cocktail baht ranges were converted at a working assumption of about 34 THB per USD, not an RBA rate. No Koh Lanta per-glass wine price was found, so wine_glass is set at about 2.75 times the beer anchor. Accommodation values are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Krabi-province island tiers, adjusted for July low (monsoon) season; no booking pages or listings were inspected. The FX observation came from a search summary of the RBA overview page and was not checked against the F11.1 table.
comparable_city_reasoning: Koh Lanta is a Krabi-province Andaman island. Food and drink anchors use Koh Lanta-specific Thai price ranges where available, with Wise and Nomad Watch averages as cross-checks. Cappuccino also draws on a Koh Lipe reference. Accommodation tiers are benchmarked to general Krabi-province island guesthouse and hotel pricing in low season.
